meta.name: aeon
meta.description: This skill should be used for time series machine learning tasks including classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation, and similarity search. Use when working with temporal data, sequential patterns, or time-indexed observations requiring specialized algorithms beyond standard ML approaches. Particularly suited for univariate and multivariate time series analysis with scikit-learn compatible APIs.

howto.what: Claude 会用 aeon 库写 Python 代码处理时间序列:分类、回归、聚类、预测、异常检测、分割、相似性搜索,也支持特征提取、距离计算和深度学习。
howto.when: 当用户要求对时间序列或多维时序数据做机器学习时触发,例如分类、预测、异常检测,或聚类、分割、相似性搜索等;需要 Python 3.10+ 环境。

howto.what_en: Claude uses the aeon library to write and run Python code for time series machine learning: classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation, similarity search, feature extraction, distances, and deep learning.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for machine learning on temporal data, e.g., classification, forecasting, anomaly detection, clustering, etc. Needs Python 3.10+ and the aeon package.
